simulations.title: Twenty jobs at once
simulations.description: Direct calls exceed the reserved allocation. A bounded invoker pulls queued jobs at 2/s. This explicit pacing is not a model of SQS trigger retries; managed allocation is instant and cold starts are excluded.

action.text: Reserved concurrency is simultaneous executions, not requests per second. Direct excess is rejected; SQS waits behind a bounded invoker, which protects the async allocation.

simulations.title: Paced requests fit
simulations.description: One job a second stays inside both allocations.
